name: RAGFlow evaluation dataset
purpose: Editable, git-tracked QA dataset for repeated Recall@12 and HIT evaluation.

versions.note: v1.4 题目与事实不变；证据 chunk ID 重新映射到 M3 qwen 解析库，3 条 DS01 证据因上游内容改写未映射，按不可评分处理。

metrics.recall_at_k: covered required facts / total required facts, macro averaged over answer cases
metrics.any_hit_at_k: fraction of answer cases with at least one required fact covered
metrics.strict_hit_at_k: fraction of answer cases with all required facts covered
